about: The bake report as a hard stop (RETRO: 'make it a hard stop'). `video` limits are summed over every take use in the cut; `take` limits are per use. Numbers are the baked ('after') side of videos/<v>/bake-report.json. mv final and mv render refuse when the last report fails; --allow-bake overrides. Set so Greener v9's bakes pass (worst take: ankle over 167 frames, near-floor travel 2.0 m); tighten them as the bake improves.
elbowFlipAbout: 2 since Hawkes Punch (2026-11-07): the doctor (Person2) bakes of doctor_turn_cold and doctor_punch keep one flipped frame each that the cleaner does not take out; tighten back to 0 when the Person2 hinge axes are read from her skeleton.
ragdollAbout: Takes built on a ragdoll (contorted by design, gallery B): their snaps and acceleration spikes are the fall itself and are left out of the video totals.
